[32541 Project Management | Subject description]
Credit points: 6

Project Management Skills are integral to the delivery of successful IT solutions. In this subject, you will use specific tools and techniques to simulate these management principles in a project of your choosing. Using a weekly workshop coupled with a two-hour interactive tutorial, you will engage in real-life discussions, case studies and group activities to solidify your knowledge. To prepare for these sessions, there are online resources, sessions with industry experts and assessments based on real-world problems, all used to assist you developing practices in preparation to perform in your career of choice.

[32541 Project Management | Learning and teaching activities]
The subject will be conducted via a weekly 3-hour workshop comprising of an interactive session combining topic presentations, discussions, case studies, informal student presentations and collaborative project activities.

 Students are expected to undertake pre-work before each weekly session which is available in Canvas. This involves watching the Linkedin Learning course - Project Management Fundamentals, content presentations on Agile Project Management.

 Subject assignments utilise a case study as the core content from which students produce authentic project related documentation aligned to professional practice.

title: Learning outcomes
content:
[32541 Project Management | Learning outcomes]
SLO1: Apply techniques appropriate for successful IT project management. (D.1)
SLO2: Construct project related documentation while working in a team environment. (E.1)
SLO3: Reflect the impact of personal and professional decisions on prepared plans. (F.1)
